plugin_desc: Sangfor EDS / aStor distributed storage SNMP collection. Collects cluster host and disk counts, management/public/private NIC health, physical capacity, block and capacity pool usage and recovery tasks, disk/LUN/host tables. OID root 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12. Does not reuse firewall snmp_sangfor collect_type or network device_* metrics. Evidence is vendor MIB alignment; live SNMP collection is not claimed.
name: Storage

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: Device uptime since the last restart, from MIB-II sysUpTime. Helps identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_host_num
metrics.description: Number of hosts in the Sangfor EDS / aStor distributed storage cluster (SANGFOR-EDS-MIB hostNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.2).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_used_ssd_num
metrics.description: Number of SSDs currently in use in the cluster (usedSSDNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.3.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_free_ssd_num
metrics.description: Number of free SSDs in the cluster (freeSSDNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.3.2).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_used_hdd_num
metrics.description: Number of HDDs currently in use in the cluster (usedHddNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.4.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_free_hdd_num
metrics.description: Number of free HDDs in the cluster (freeHddNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.4.2).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_normal_manage_nic_num
metrics.description: Count of management-plane NICs in normal state (normalManageNetworkAdapterNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.5.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_abnormal_manage_nic_num
metrics.description: Count of management-plane NICs in abnormal state (abnormalManageNetworkAdapterNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.5.2). A value greater than 0 indicates management-network faults.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_normal_public_nic_num
metrics.description: Count of public-plane NICs in normal state (normalPublicNetworkAdapterNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.5.3).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_abnormal_public_nic_num
metrics.description: Count of public-plane NICs in abnormal state (abnormalPublicNetworkAdapterNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.5.4). A value greater than 0 indicates public-network faults.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_normal_private_nic_num
metrics.description: Count of private-plane NICs in normal state (normalPrivateNetworkAdapterNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.5.5).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_abnormal_private_nic_num
metrics.description: Count of private-plane NICs in abnormal state (abnormalPrivateNetworkAdapterNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.5.6). A value greater than 0 indicates storage-backend network faults.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_total_physical_bytes
metrics.description: Total physical capacity of the cluster in bytes (totalPhysicalBytes, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.6.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_used_physical_bytes
metrics.description: Used physical capacity of the cluster in bytes (usedPhysicalBytes, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.6.2).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_free_physical_bytes
metrics.description: Free physical capacity of the cluster in bytes (freePhyicalBytes, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.6.3).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_physical_usage_percent
metrics.description: Physical capacity usage of the cluster as a percentage, derived from usedPhysicalBytes / totalPhysicalBytes.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_block_pool_num
metrics.description: Number of block storage pools (blockStoragePoolNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.7.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_cluster_capacity_pool_num
metrics.description: Number of capacity storage pools (capacityStoragePoolNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.1.7.2).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_block_pool_total_bytes
metrics.description: Total capacity of the block storage pool in bytes (blockStorageTotalCapacityBytes, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.2.1.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_block_pool_used_bytes
metrics.description: Used capacity of the block storage pool in bytes (blockStorageUsedCapacityBytes, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.2.1.2).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_block_pool_available_bytes
metrics.description: Available capacity of the block storage pool in bytes (blockStorageAvailableCapacityBytes, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.2.1.3).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_block_pool_usage_rate
metrics.description: Block storage pool usage converted from the vendor DisplayString ratio 0..1 to a 0-100 percentage (blockStorageCapacityUsageRate, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.2.1.4).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_block_pool_recovery_task_num
metrics.description: Number of data-recovery / rebuild tasks on the block storage pool (blockStorageDataRecoveryTaskNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.2.2.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_block_pool_sync_task_num
metrics.description: Number of syncing / heal tasks on the block storage pool (blockStorageSyncingTaskNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.2.2.2).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_block_pool_rebalance_task_num
metrics.description: Number of rebalance / migrate tasks on the block storage pool (blockStorageDataRebalanceTaskNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.2.2.3).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_block_pool_subhealth_task_num
metrics.description: Number of sub-health recovery tasks on the block storage pool (blockStorageSubHealthRecoveryTaskNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.2.2.4).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_block_pool_status
metrics.description: Block storage pool status mapped to 1=normal, 2=abnormal, 3=unknown. Empty or notPresent maps to 1; vendor-literal unknown maps to 3 and does not alert. Alert only on =2.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_capacity_pool_total_bytes
metrics.description: Total capacity of the capacity storage pool in bytes (capacityTotalBytes, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.3.1.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_capacity_pool_used_bytes
metrics.description: Used capacity of the capacity storage pool in bytes (usedCapacityBytes, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.3.1.2).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_capacity_pool_available_bytes
metrics.description: Available capacity of the capacity storage pool in bytes (availableCapacityBytes, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.3.1.3).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_capacity_pool_usage_rate
metrics.description: Capacity pool usage converted from the vendor DisplayString ratio 0..1 to a 0-100 percentage (capacityUsageRate, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.3.1.4).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_capacity_pool_recovery_task_num
metrics.description: Number of rebuild tasks on the capacity pool (dataRecoveryTaskNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.3.2.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_capacity_pool_rebalance_task_num
metrics.description: Number of migrate / rebalance tasks on the capacity pool (dataRebalanceTaskNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.3.2.2).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_capacity_pool_subhealth_task_num
metrics.description: Number of sub-health recovery tasks on the capacity pool (subHealthRecoveryTaskNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.3.2.3).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_capacity_pool_daemon_status
metrics.description: OSD / storage daemon status (storageDaemonStatus, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.3.3). Vendor strings normal/error map to 1/2; empty maps to 1; unknown maps to 3. Alert only on =2.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_capacity_pool_pg_status
metrics.description: Placement-group / replicated-group status (replicatedGroupStatus, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.3.4). Vendor strings normal/error map to 1/2; empty maps to 1; unknown maps to 3. Alert only on =2.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_capacity_pool_status
metrics.description: Capacity pool status mapped to 1=normal, 2=abnormal, 3=unknown. Empty or notPresent maps to 1; vendor-literal unknown maps to 3 and does not alert. Alert only on =2.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_fs_nfs_con_num
metrics.description: Current NFS connection count (nfsConNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.5.1.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_fs_cifs_con_num
metrics.description: Current CIFS connection count (cifsConNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.5.2.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_fs_ftp_con_num
metrics.description: Current FTP connection count (ftpConNum, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.5.3.1).

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_lun_usage_rate
metrics.description: LUN usage converted from the vendor DisplayString ratio 0..1 to a 0-100 percentage (lunUsageRate, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.4.3.1.2). Indexed by lunName.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_disk_status
metrics.description: Disk status (diskStatus, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.7.1.1.3). Vendor strings online/offline map to 1/2; empty or notPresent maps to 1; unknown maps to 3. Alert only on =2. Indexed by diskName.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_disk_size_bytes
metrics.description: Disk size in bytes (diskSize, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.7.1.1.6). Indexed by diskName.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_disk_usage_rate
metrics.description: Disk usage converted from the vendor DisplayString ratio 0..1 to a 0-100 percentage (diskUsageRate, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.7.1.1.7). Indexed by diskName.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_disk_bad_sector
metrics.description: HDD bad-sector status (diskBadSector, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.7.1.1.9). Vendor strings normal map to 1; warn/error map to 2; empty maps to 1; unknown maps to 3. Alert only on =2.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_disk_life_percent
metrics.description: SSD remaining life percentage (diskLifePre, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.7.1.1.10). Indexed by diskName.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_host_online_status
metrics.description: Storage host online status (hostOnlineStatus, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.7.3.1.3). Parsed from vendor strings when possible: online/up→1, offline/down→2, empty→1, unknown→3. Alert only on =2. Indexed by hostName.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_host_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Storage host CPU usage (cpuUsageRate, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.7.3.1.5). Converted to a 0-100 percentage when the vendor string or number is parseable. Indexed by hostName.

metrics.name: sangfor_eds_host_mem_usage
metrics.description: Storage host memory usage (memUsageRate, 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047.2.12.7.3.1.6). Treated as 0-100 when greater than 1, otherwise converted from a 0..1 ratio. Indexed by hostName.
